purpose: On-demand sources for the non-distributed shader-pack corpus: real application shader sets kept whole, one directory per set, for multi-module (ARXP) benchmarks. Built by scripts/build_pack_corpus.py into corpus/packs/. Provenance and selection: docs/benchmark-corpus.md.

sources.name: wicked
sources.note: Wicked Engine v0.72.139 release; the Linux editor binary embeds its DXC shader dump as zstd frames.

sources.name: 0ad
sources.note: 0 A.D. 0.28.0 shipped Vulkan SPIR-V (shaders/spirv in mod.zip, content-hash named, with the XML program/permutation maps). Only mod.zip is kept from the 1.4 GB stream.

sources.name: sascha
sources.note: Sascha Willems' Vulkan examples, committed .spv for the same examples from glslang, DXC and Slang.

sources.name: xenia
sources.note: Xenia emulator Vulkan shaders, committed as C headers of uint32 words.

sources.name: angle
sources.note: ANGLE Vulkan back-end internal shader permutations, committed as gzip-compressed C byte arrays.

sources.name: quake3e
sources.note: Quake3e Vulkan renderer shader permutations, committed as C byte arrays in shader_data.c.

sources.name: skia
sources.note: SkSL compiler SPIR-V goldens (*.asm.*), assembled with spirv-as; the assembler stamps generator 0x70000, so with a pinned target environment the output does not depend on the assembler version. Goldens that do not assemble are skipped.
